newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices pushed up by shortage.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices pushed up by shortage.

text.p: A shortage of coffee pushed Kenyan coffee prices up at the weekly coffee auction on Tuesday, traders said.
Grade C's averaged $156.5 per 50-kg bag from $150 on November 26, while AB's averaged $157 unchanged.
"A short supply of coffee coupled with the fact that traders had to meet their shipment commitments, pushed the coffee prices up on average," one trader said.

Tuesday's auction was the last one for the year. Auctions will resume on January 7, 1997. The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 21,988 60-kg bags of coffee it had on offer compared to 24,651 bags sold on November 26.
